A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] served as '''messenger''' for the [[Dantooine Jedi Enclave Council|Dantooine Enclave Council]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars|Mandalorian War]]. They received a message from accused Jedi [[Zayne Carrick]] for Master [[Vandar Tokare]].<ref name="KOTOR4" />
